titulo_ja: という と いえば (3)

いけば.es: (forma ば de いく) si vas; ir

乗れば.en: if you go up; if you take (a transport)

聞いたら.en: if you ask; when you hear

texto: To suggest an option: form & **いい**: **でんしゃ で いけば いい です** (you could go by train).

You can also give a tip: form ∞ + **いい**: **まいにち すこし ずつ べんきょう したら いい です** (you could study a little every day). **ばいい** and **たらいい** overlap a lot; **ずつ** separately provides the idea of moving forward little by little.
